mode: Built-in ImageGen concepts, followed by native 16x16 pixel cleanup in tools/build-item-textures.ps1. Imported netherite horse armor replaces its original concept; provenance and MIT license are in NOTICE. Original entity UV maps are authored for the vanilla horse mesh and custom saddle geometry.

prompts.name: iron_horseshoes
prompts.prompt: Create one Minecraft-style inventory item texture: iron metal horseshoe, cool silver grey. A single chunky U-shaped horseshoe seen straight on, opening at top, with two nail holes on each arm. Designed on exactly a 16 by 16 pixel canvas: very large flat color pixel blocks, no small details, no gradients, no antialiasing. Symmetrical thick clear U shape centered filling 12x13 logical pixels, transparent background. Limited five-tone material palette with dark outlines and bright edge highlights. No text or labels, no scene, no extra objects. Render a nearest-neighbor enlarged preview of this 16x16 game texture.

revision.horseshoe: Clean up the iron horseshoe as a symmetrical U with exactly five-pixel-wide arms and two single-pixel dark nail holes per arm. Keep silver metal, transparent background, flat pixel clusters. The four material variants use one exact shared grid and recoloring only.
revision.passenger: Clean up the passenger saddle preserving tan brown leather, cyan blanket, brass stirrups and the double-seat idea. Simplify to connected flat clusters readable at 16x16.
revision.warrior: Clean up the warrior saddle preserving oxblood leather, red blanket, silver reinforcement and stirrups. Simplify to connected flat clusters readable at 16x16.
revision.wanderer: Clean up the wanderer saddle preserving brown leather, green blanket, side satchel and tan bedroll. Simplify to connected flat clusters readable at 16x16.
revision.cleanup: Transcribe and simplify ImageGen concepts onto the explicit 16x16 grids in tools/build-item-textures.ps1. Use solid opaque palette entries and transparent empty cells, without resampling.
